answer: Volkswagen reported four deaths from work-related accidents or ill health in 2025: one Volkswagen Group employee, one non-employee, and two other workers such as value-chain workers at Group sites.

evidence.quote: There were 4 (4) deaths as a result of work-related accidents or ill health during the reporting year.
One of these deaths related to a Volkswagen Group employee. One death related to a non-employee. Two deaths related to other workers
